writer_summary: Misc updates across the trip tracking and offer scoring code.

result.summary: This diff is a comprehensive bug-fix pass that corrects ten serious issues: data-isolation failures, multiple inverted authorization conditions, a missing password verification step, an expiry-less JWT, and a destructive delete-all-other-users'-items bug. Every finding in this diff is a resolved defect, and all fixes appear correct. No new issues are introduced.

findings.issue: read_items had no owner filter, exposing all users items to any authenticated user. Fix adds .where(Item.owner_id == current_user.id).
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: read_item authorization was inverted: denied access to the real owner and allowed access to everyone else. Fix corrects != operator.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: Email conflict check was inverted: blocked the current user from keeping their own email and allowed others to steal it. Fix corrects != operator.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: update_password_me did not reject an incorrect current password; anyone could change a password without knowing it. Fix adds verified check.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: delete_user_me guard was inverted: allowed superusers to delete themselves and blocked normal users. Fix corrects the condition.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: delete_user deleted items belonging to everyone EXCEPT the target user (!= user_id). Fix corrects to == user_id.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: create_access_token omitted 'exp' claim, producing tokens that never expire. Fix adds 'exp': expire to the payload.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: update_item used exclude_unset=False, overwriting all fields with defaults on partial updates. Fix changes to exclude_unset=True.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: reset_password returned 404 with 'User not found', leaking user existence. Fix returns 400 with 'Invalid token'.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: update_user_me accepted UserUpdate instead of UserUpdateMe, potentially allowing privilege escalation via is_superuser field. Fix uses UserUpdateMe.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.
